name: build_a_modern_ai_developer_portfolio_workflow
trigger:
Build a modern AI developer portfolio website called VEXORITE LABS.

Create a complete, polished, working website with:

DESIGN:
- Dark futuristic developer/AI aesthetic
- Black/deep dark background
- Animated gradient background
- Glassmorphism cards and panels
- Glowing cyan/purple accent effects
- Smooth hover animations
- Responsive desktop and mobile layout
- Clean modern typography
- Professional hackathon-demo quality UI
- No external image assets

SECTIONS:

1. HERO
- Large heading: "VEXORITE LABS"
- Subtitle: "AI that turns ideas into working software."
- Short description explaining that VEXORITE is an AI-powered desktop development agent.
- Add prominent "Build with VEXORITE" button.
- Add a secondary "Explore Projects" button.

2. ABOUT
Explain VEXORITE as an AI desktop development agent that can:
- Understand natural-language commands
- Create and modify files
- Run terminal commands
- Build websites
- Start local development servers
- Verify websites automatically
- Create reusable workflows
- Push approved work to GitHub
- Deploy approved projects to Vercel

3. PROJECTS
Create attractive project cards for:
- VEXORITE — AI-powered desktop development agent
- GhostnSweeper — spooky interactive web game
- THE_HASHTAG — student events and opportunities platform

Each card should have:
- Project name
- Short description
- Technology tags
- Hover animation
- "View Project" style button

4. HOW IT WORKS
Show a visual workflow:

Natural Language Command
→ AI Planning
→ Tool Execution
→ Website Verification
→ LocalTunnel Preview
→ User Approval
→ GitHub
→ Vercel

Make this section visually impressive.

5. CAPABILITIES
Show cards for:
- AI Planning
- File System Control
- Terminal Execution
- Website Generation
- Website Verification
- GitHub Integration
- Vercel Deployment
- Workflow Memory

6. TECH STACK
Display:
- Python
- FastAPI
- React
- JavaScript
- Featherless AI
- GitHub
- Vercel
- LocalTunnel

7. CONTACT
Create a working contact-style section with:
- Name input
- Email input
- Message textarea
- Submit button

The form does not need a real backend, but JavaScript should prevent the default submission and display a success message.

8. NAVIGATION
Create a fixed navigation bar with:
- Home
- About
- Projects
- How It Works
- Contact

Navigation should smoothly scroll to sections.

9. DARK/LIGHT MODE
Add a functional dark/light mode toggle using vanilla JavaScript.
The entire website should visibly change between dark and light themes.

10. INTERACTIONS
Add:
- Smooth scrolling
- Button hover effects
- Card hover effects
- Scroll reveal animations
- Animated background elements
- Mobile navigation
- Interactive theme toggle
- Contact form success message

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Use ONLY HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.
- Create exactly these files:
  index.html
  style.css
  script.js
- Keep HTML, CSS and JavaScript separated.
- No React.
- No external image assets.
- No external backend.
- Make everything responsive.
- Make sure the website actually works when opened through a local HTTP server.
- Do not create a GitHub repository.

IMPORTANT EXECUTION WORKFLOW:

After creating the website:

1. Start the local website server.
2. Use the exact port used by the server.
3. Verify the website using check_url.
4. Confirm that the website returns HTTP 200.
5. Start LocalTunnel using the exact same port.
6. Return the public LocalTunnel URL.
7. STOP and wait for my explicit approval.

EXISTING GITHUB REPOSITORY:
https://github.com/ksaicharan0047j-dot/HACKWAVE3.0

CRITICAL RULES:
- The GitHub repository already exists.
- NEVER create a GitHub repository.
- Do NOT run git_push before approval.
- Do NOT deploy to Vercel before approval.
- Do NOT commit/push/deploy anything before approval.
- First show me the verified LocalTunnel preview URL.
- STOP and wait for my explicit approval.

After I explicitly approve:
- Push the project to the existing GitHub repository.
- Then deploy the approved project to Vercel.
- Return the GitHub URL and Vercel deployment URL.
